## Checklist (STANDARD.md)

- [ ] `metadata.version` bumped for every changed skill (CI enforces this)
- [ ] `python3 tools/validate_skills.py` passes locally
- [ ] Description says what the skill does and when to use it (with trigger phrases)
- [ ] `SKILL.md` under 500 lines; detail moved into `references/`
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal paths; user config lives outside the repo
- [ ] Tried the skill once on a real prompt
